question_text: Outline how each of two network threats, ransom ware and SQL injection, could damage an organization’s data.
adaptation_rationale: Extracts within-scope malicious-data-loss reasoning; narrows generic cause-list to explicitly included network vulnerabilities.
solution: Ransom ware can encrypt or deny access to stored files.; Without a sound recovery copy, the organization may lose usable access to them.; SQL injection can manipulate an inadequately protected database query.; A malicious query may alter/delete records, damaging their integrity/availability.

marking_points.criterion: Ransom ware can encrypt or deny access to stored files.
